data.title: Castellani's paint (carbol-fuchsin paint)
data.summary: Topical antifungals · Magenta dye (basic fuchsin) + phenol + resorcinol + boric acid in acetone/alcohol
data.body:
_More from Khopkar · Topical antifungals_

**Class:** Magenta dye (basic fuchsin) + phenol + resorcinol + boric acid in acetone/alcohol

## Mechanism of action
- Antifungal, antibacterial, drying and mildly keratolytic

## Indications in dermatology & STI
- Intertrigo, interdigital tinea pedis and candidiasis, weeping toe webs, chronic paronychia, napkin dermatitis (colourless versions)

## Dose & formulations
- Paint once or twice daily; let dry

## Adverse effects
- Red-purple staining (colourless variant available), irritation; phenol toxicity if used on large areas in infants

## Contraindications
- Large areas, infants (phenol absorption)

## Pregnancy & lactation
Small areas acceptable.

## Viva points
- Traditional drying antifungal paint for macerated toe webs

_Sources: Khopkar ch.19 (Traditional antifungal remedies — Castellani's paint). Facts summarised in our own words; Wolverton followed where books differ._
